name: deployment-strategy
description: Select and implement deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, rolling, feature flags) that minimize risk, enable zero-downtime deployments, and provide fast rollback capabilities.
inputs: deployment target (Kubernetes, cloud services, VMs, containers)
traffic routing capability (load balancer, service mesh, DNS)
outputs: deployment strategy document (selected strategy, rationale, traffic shifting plan)
traffic management plan (routing configuration, gradual rollout percentages)
rollback procedure (automated triggers, manual steps, database strategy)
validation criteria (health checks, success metrics, error thresholds)
infrastructure configuration (load balancer, service mesh, DNS)
